references.text: God gives the first instruction to place the mercy seat on top of the ark of the testimony, which Exodus 26:34 repeats in connection with the furnishings of the tabernacle.
Moses carries out the command by placing the mercy seat upon the ark, as was commanded in Exodus 26:34.
The Lord speaks about the mercy seat that is on the ark and mentions that He will appear in the cloud over the mercy seat in the Most Holy Place.
The high priest shall sprinkle blood on the mercy seat on the Day of Atonement, showing the central role of the mercy seat in the Most Holy Place.
Solomon's temple has an innermost room, the Most Holy Place, where the ark of the covenant was to stand, in accordance with the arrangement of the tabernacle.
The priests carried the Lord's ark of the covenant into the Most Holy Place in the temple, under the wings of the cherubim.

The book of Hebrews describes the Most Holy Place with the ark of the covenant and the mercy seat (ἱλαστήριον) overshadowed by the glorious cherubim, making direct reference to the furnishings of the tabernacle.
Both verses define the liturgical topography of the Most Holy Place and connect the mercy seat with God's meeting with Moses.
Lev 16:13 shows the practical and theological function of the mercy seat established in Exod 26:34.
